given.note: S2-22's question oq-s2-22-sam, which reads back who takes bookings (commit-limit-3-no-exact-yes.json: limit 3, an exact yes to that read-back, and its freshReadBack outcome; README v1 round 2 item 8), answered 'hmm': both Haiku reads agree on ask about that one question (K-02 v1 ask: a bare reply is no choice), and the gate answers the part asked with no limit run. The answer sends the question again in outbox-s2-22-sam-hmm-1 and raises its ask count (written: oq-s2-22-sam at version 3): the schema takes it, and askedResendsQuestion alone refuses it, since a re-send is only for a question stored with no options and no read-back, which no fixture this exchange runs after shows S2-22's to be (README v1.12 default 193: the row names the question, so its send becomes the question's send time, and a yes sent before it would no longer be sent since the read-back went out: actions/src/gate/limit-3/exact-yes.ts lines 425 to 427). The request's turn carries the service and chat id a v1.5 caller puts there (README v1.5 default 135), as commit-s1-02-asked.json's does, so the read-back is the one reason. With no outbox row and nothing in written it is accepted: the turn stays silent, as today.
